source.author: vignesh_warar
source.text:
Hi HN, Clary is an iPhone app that reads your notifications in the sender's own voice, from WhatsApp, iMessage and more, and keeps them as a history on your phone.

How it works:

- iOS 27 added a Shortcuts trigger, "When I receive a notification". Clary ships a ready-made automation for 16 apps that hands each notification (app, title, text) to the app. They are stored on the iPhone, not sent to a server, and sorted Gmail-style into Messages, Updates and Promotions by Apple's on-device model.

- For a voice, you send someone a link. They record about 20 seconds once in the browser and agree first. Clary clones the voice on the iPhone with Qwen3-TTS. The ~2 GB model ships inside the app.

Limits: iPhone 15 Pro or newer with iOS 27. It only keeps notifications that arrive after you turn the automation on, and only what the notification preview shows.

Free: history, sorting and 2 plays, Pro: $29.99 once.

Website: https://hiclary.com Demo (36 s): https://youtu.be/HKzNUla1D-Q App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6832212509

Appreciate any feedback :)
source.title: Show HN: Clary reads iOS notifications in the sender's voice and keeps a history
